cnd12:2.1: yeme pubbe viyākaṃsūti: ‘ye’ti: yo ca bāvarī brāhmaṇo, ye caññe tassa ācariyā, te sakaṃ diṭṭhiṃ sakaṃ khantiṃ sakaṃ ruciṃ sakaṃ laddhiṃ ajjhāsayaṃ sakaṃ adhippāyaṃ vyākaṃsu ācikkhiṃsu, desayiṃsu paññapiṃsu paṭṭhapiṃsu vivariṃsu vibhajiṃsu uttānīakaṃsu pakāsesunti
cnd12:3.1: huraṃ gotama sāsanāti: huraṃ gotamasāsanā, paraṃ gotamasāsanā, pure gotamasāsanā, paṭhamataraṃ gotamasāsanā buddhasāsanā jinasāsanā tathāgatasāsanā, devadevasāsanā, arahantasāsanāti
cnd12:4.1: iccāsi iti bhavissatīti: evaṃ kira āsi, evaṃ kira bhavissatīti
cnd12:5.1: sabbaṃ taṃ itihītihanti: sabbaṃ taṃ itihītihaṃ, itikirāya, paramparāya piṭakasampadāya takkahetu nayahetu ākāraparivitakkena diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā na sāmaṃ sayamabhiññātaṃ na attapaccakkhadhammaṃ kathayiṃsūti
cnd12:6.1: sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhananti: sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ vitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ saṅkappavaḍḍhanaṃ kāmavitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ vyāpādavitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ ñātivitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ janapadavitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ amarāvitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ parānuddayatā paṭisaṃyuttavitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ lābhasakkārasilokapaṭisaṃyuttavitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ anavaññatti paṭisaṃyuttavitakkavaḍḍhananti
cnd12:7.1: nāhaṃ tattha abhiraminti nāhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ na vindiṃ nādhigacchiṃ na paṭilabhinti
cnd12:10.4: ‘dhamma’nti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhāne cattāro sammappadhāne cattāro iddhipāde pañcindriyāni pañcabalāni sattabojjhaṅge ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ nibbānañca nibbānagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ akkhāhi ācikkhāhi, desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehīti
cnd12:11.4: taṇhānigghātanaṃ taṇhāpahānaṃ. taṇhāvūpasamaṃ taṇhāpaṭinissaggaṃ taṇhā paṭippassaddhaṃ amataṃ nibbānaṃ.
cnd12:11.5: munīti ‘monaṃ’ vuccati ñāṇaṃ, …pe… saṅgajālamaticca so munīti
cnd12:12.1: yaṃ viditvā sato caranti: yaṃ viditaṃ katvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā
cnd12:12.2: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti viditaṃ katvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā
cnd12:12.5: ‘yaṃ kiñci samuyadadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma’nti viditaṃ katvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.
cnd12:12.9: caranti caranto viharanto irīyanto vattento pālento yapento yāpentoti
cnd12:13.4: loketi apāyaloke manussaloke devaloke khandhaloke dhātuloke āyatanaloke.
cnd12:13.5: tare loke visattikanti lokevesā visattikā lokevetaṃ visattikaṃ sato tareyya, uttareyyaṃ patareyyaṃ samatikkameyya vītivatteyyāti
cnd12:16.4: mutanti ghānena ghāyitaṃ jivhāya sāyitaṃ, kāyena phuṭṭhaṃ,
cnd12:17.2: cakkhuṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, sotaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, ghānaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, jivhā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, kāyo loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, mano loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ,
cnd12:17.3: rūpā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, saddā loke-gandhā loke-rasā loke-phoṭṭhabbā loke-dhammā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ,
cnd12:17.4: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ loke-ghānaviññāṇaṃ loke-jivhāviññāṇaṃ loke-kāyaviññāṇaṃ loke-manoviññāṇaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, cakkhusamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, sota-ghāna-jivhā-kāyasamphasso loke-manosamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ,
cnd12:17.5: cakkhusamphassajā vedanā loke …pe… sota-ghāna-jivhā-kāya-manosamphassajā vedanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ,
cnd12:17.6: rūpasaññā loke-saddasaññā loke …pe… gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabba-dhammasaññā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, rūpasañcetanā loke …pe… sadda-gandha-rasaphoṭṭhabba dhammasañcetanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ,
cnd12:17.7: rūpataṇhā loke-saddataṇhā loke …pe… gandha- rasa-phoṭṭhabba-dhamma taṇhā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ,
cnd12:17.8: rūpavitakko loke …pe… sadda- gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabba-dhammavitakko loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ.
cnd12:17.9: rūpavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, saddavicāro loke …pe… gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabba-dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpanti
cnd12:18.2: ‘chandarāgo’ti “yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandi kāmataṇhā kāmasineho kāmapariḷāho kāmamucchā kāmajjhosānaṃ kāmogho kāmayogo kāmūpādānaṃ kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ.”
cnd12:18.3: chandarāga vinodananti chandarāgappahānaṃ chandarāgavūpasamaṃ, chandarāgapaṭinissaggaṃ chandarāgapaṭippassaddhi amataṃ nibbānanti
cnd12:19.1: nibbānapadamaccutanti nibbānapadaṃ tāṇapadaṃ lenapadaṃ saraṇapadaṃ abhayapadaṃ,
cnd12:22.3: “yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
cnd12:22.4: “aññāyāti aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā:
cnd12:22.5: ‘sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā,
cnd12:22.8: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā’
cnd12:23.2: ‘diṭṭhadhammā’ti: diṭṭhadhammā, ñātadhammā, tulitadhammā, tīritadhammā, vibhūtadhammā, vibhāvitadhammā,
cnd12:23.4: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti diṭṭhadhammā ñātadhammā tulitadhammā tīritadhammā vibhūtadhammā vibhāvitadhammā,
cnd12:23.5: abhinibbutāti rāgassa nibbāpitattā nibbutā, dosassa nibbāpitattā nibbutā, mohassa nibbāpitattā nibbutā, kodhassa …pe… upanāhassa …pe… sabbākusalābhisaṃkhārānaṃ santattā samitattā vūpasamitattā nijjhātattā nibbutattā vigatattā paṭippassaddhattā santā upasantā vūpasantā nibbutā paṭippassaddhāti
cnd12:24.2: ‘upasantā’ti: rāgassa upasamitattā nibbāpitattā upasantā, dosassa-mohassa-kodhassa-upanāhassa …pe… sabbākusalābhi saṃkhārānaṃ santattā samitattā upasamitattā nijjhātattā nibbutattā vigatattā paṭippassaddhattā santā upasantā vūpasantā nibbutā paṭippassaddhāti ‘upasantā.’
cnd12:24.4: sadāti sadā sabbadā sabbakālaṃ niccakālaṃ dhuvakālaṃ sattaṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ udakodhikajātaṃ avīci santati sahitaṃ phassitaṃ, purebhattaṃ pacchābhattaṃ purimayāmaṃ majjhimayāmaṃ pacchimayāmaṃ kāḷe juṇhe vasse hemante gimhe purime vayo khandhe majjhime vayokhandhe pacchime vayokhandheti
cnd12:25.2: yo rāgo sārāgo …pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ,
cnd12:25.5: tiṇṇā loke visattikanti lokevesā visattikā, lokevetaṃ visattikaṃ tiṇṇā uttiṇṇā nittiṇṇā atikkantā samatikkantā vītivattāti
